name: How much does it cost to replace foggy sliding door glass?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace foggy sliding door glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace foggy sliding door glass varies based on several factors, including the size of the glass unit, the type of glass (e.g., tempered, low-E, obscure), frame type, and labor in the Bay Area. Expect a range that reflects custom glass fabrication and professional installation. For an accurate estimate, it's best to have a contractor assess your specific door to provide a detailed quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement costs depend on glass size, type, frame, and labor. A precise quote requires an on-site assessment.
